scenarios.name: BIT1 — restored BOOKING INTENT TEST scheduling language fires Signal 0

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Can you fit me in for a remedial massage this week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 0 (via the restored BOOKING INTENT TEST 'scheduling language' trigger): speaks one filler phrase, then calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with implied_service capturing remedial massage. FAIL if it routes this to FAST CLASSIFY rule 3a instead of firing Signal 0, or if it fails to recognize this as booking intent.

scenarios.name: BIT2 — next-available query for a named service is booking intent (fleet fix 015edeb)

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
What's the soonest I can get a lymphatic drainage appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 0 via the BOOKING INTENT TEST 'next-available query for a specific service' bullet — speaks one filler phrase, then calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with implied_service capturing lymphatic drainage. FAIL if it routes to FAST CLASSIFY rule 3a (a plain availability lookup) instead of Signal 0, or fails to recognize this as booking intent at all.

scenarios.name: PM1 — preference-free availability after a practitioner was named earlier resolves via the practitioner map

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Does Renee do remedial massage?
Yes, Renee offers Remedial Massage — Standard Appointment. Did you have any other questions?
Great, I'll take whatever's soonest with her.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 0's preference-free-availability branch. Identifies Renee via method B (most recent practitioner mention in history), matches her to 'Remedial Massage - Standard Appointment' via the practitioner map, and calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with payload including practitioner_preference='Renee Fujimoto' and implied_service='Remedial Massage - Standard Appointment'. FAIL if it omits the practitioner/service fields, or guesses a different appointment type than the map specifies.

scenarios.name: MS1 — unspecified massage-type availability question fires massage_survey silently

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
What massage types do you have available this week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires FAST CLASSIFY rule 3b (no specific massage type named): zero spoken output, calls universal_router intent='massage_survey' with called_number/caller_id and payload only (no message spoken this turn). FAIL if it speaks anything this turn, if it routes to rule 3a instead, or if it fails to call massage_survey (e.g. because massage_survey isn't recognized as a valid intent).

scenarios.name: FC1 — condition question routes to FAST CLASSIFY rule 1 (EXECUTION SEQUENCE), not out-of-scope

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Would massage help with my lower back pain?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires FAST CLASSIFY rule 1 (condition/ailment question) → EXECUTION SEQUENCE directly, answers connecting the complaint to a relevant service (e.g. Remedial Massage), does not list service_categories verbatim, appends the closing line 'Is there anything else I can help you with?'. FAIL if it treats this as out-of-scope, or lists service_categories instead of answering directly.

scenarios.name: FC2 — genuinely out-of-scope question routes to OUT-OF-SCOPE OFFER (verifies the rule-2 numbering fix didn't break routing)

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
What's the WiFi password here?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires FAST CLASSIFY rule 2 (does not relate to the clinic) → OUT-OF-SCOPE OFFER handler: since caller_first_name may be empty, says 'That's outside what I can help with here — I'll pass that on. Can I get your name?' (or, if caller_first_name were set, the TOOL+SPEAK branch). FAIL if it tries to answer the WiFi question directly, or misroutes to MISHEARD FAST-PATH.

scenarios.name: FE1 — gap fee question answered via SCOPED EXCEPTION, not deflected to a billing callback

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Is there a gap fee for lymphatic drainage under my health fund?

scenarios.expected_behavior: The FINANCIAL ENQUIRY SCOPED EXCEPTION applies (private health coverage question) — does NOT offer 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?'. Continues to FAST CLASSIFY / the private-health-insurance rule instead. FAIL if it offers the billing callback for this question.

scenarios.name: HICAPS1 — all services are HICAPS-claimable (Bartosz deactivated, no exceptions remain)

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Are your services covered by private health insurance?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires FAST CLASSIFY rule 5: answers that all services are eligible for private health insurance rebates through HICAPS (no practitioner exceptions). Ends with closing line. No tool call. FAIL if it mentions Bartosz or any HICAPS exception, or if it says 'most' services rather than 'all'.

scenarios.name: SIG1 — SIGNAL CONTINUITY: reply to the callback phone/reason prompt continues the signal, doesn't re-evaluate FAST CLASSIFY

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Can someone call me back about setting up a payment plan?
Would you like me to get someone from the team to call you back?
Yes please.
What's the best number to reach you on and what's it regarding?
It's 0412 345 678, about a payment plan for my treatment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: SIGNAL CONTINUITY applies: treats this reply as the continuation of the CALLBACK REQUEST signal (not a fresh FAST CLASSIFY evaluation). Collects name if caller_first_name is empty, or proceeds straight to the tool call if already known — either way it speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='callback_request' with the reason captured, followed by intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if it re-evaluates from FAST CLASSIFY and treats the phone number/reason as an unrelated new question.

scenarios.name: CANNOT ANSWER OFFER — unanswerable equipment/brand detail offers to email instead of guessing

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
What brand of cupping equipment do you use for the Myofascial Cupping treatment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node does not invent or guess a specific brand/equipment detail not present in service_categories, practitioners_comma, practitioner_services, service_ids, or location_addresses, and instead says it doesn't have that specific detail and offers to email the question through to the clinic. FAIL if it states a specific brand as fact, or if it flatly refuses without offering to email the question.

scenarios.name: CANNOT ANSWER OFFER — caller agrees and gives name, node emails the question and wraps up

history.content: Do you take AHM specifically, not just HICAPS in general?
I don't have that specific detail on hand -- would you like me to email that through to the clinic for you?
Yes please, it's Priya.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set and, in the same turn, calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with payload containing caller_name='Priya' and message_body referencing the AHM question, then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if it asks for the name again, skips the leave_message call, fabricates an answer about AHM coverage, or claims the message was sent without calling the tool.

scenarios.name: AR1 — aromatherapy massage availability question routes to rule 3a, not massage_survey

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
Do you have any aromatherapy massages available this week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires FAST CLASSIFY rule 3a (specific massage type named — 'aromatherapy' is on the EXCLUSION list), not rule 3b. Zero spoken output, calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with info_pivot_source='node_8', implied_service naming an aromatherapy appointment type, and timeframe_raw if a date/time was given. FAIL if it calls massage_survey instead, or if it speaks a spoken answer without calling the tool.

scenarios.name: SD1 — caller asks what reflexology involves gets an EXECUTION SEQUENCE answer, not CANNOT ANSWER OFFER

history.content: This is Totally Well, how can I help?
What is reflexology and who does it here?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Answerable from the new Reflexology service description (targeted pressure on points on the feet, offered by Renee). Speaks a short spoken answer naming reflexology and Renee, then the CLOSING LINE. FAIL if it routes to CANNOT ANSWER OFFER (offering to email the clinic) since the KNOWLEDGE GATE source now covers this, or if it fabricates detail not in the service description.
